knowledge:
- key_parameters: methylation.data=A matrix of DNA methylation beta values with CpG sites in rows and samples in columns ;; gene.expression.data=A matrix of matched gene expression data (TPM, RPKM, FPKM, etc.) with genes in rows and samples in columns ;; sample.info=A dataframe mapping samples to study groups with columns 'primary' (sample names) and 'sample.type' (group names) ;; group.1=Character string indicating the experimental group (e.g., 'Cancer') ;; group.2=Character string indicating the control group (e.g., 'Normal') ;; mode=Character string specifying the analytic mode ('Regular', 'Enhancer', 'miRNA', 'lncRNA') ;; roadmap.epigenome.ids=Character string specifying the reference cell/tissue type ID (e.g., 'E096') from Roadmap Epigenomics, required for 'Enhancer' mode and some plotting functions ;; met.platform=Character string specifying the methylation platform (e.g., 'HM450', 'HM27') ;; OutputRoot=Character string specifying the directory to save outputs ;; cores=Integer specifying the number of CPU cores to use for parallel processing ;; doBatchCorrection=Optional parameter to correct batch effects using 'Seurat' or 'Combat'
- alternatives: doBatchCorrection can use 'Seurat' (highly time-efficient) or 'Combat' (slower, requires multiple CPU cores)
- when_to_use: Use when integrating high-throughput DNA methylation (beta values) and matched gene expression data to identify functional DNA methylation changes across different genetic elements (promoters, enhancers, miRNAs, lncRNAs) between two study groups (e.g., disease vs. normal).
- pitfalls: Standard RNA-seq processing methods may not detect a sufficient amount of lncRNAs; a specialized pipeline (PMID: 31808800) is recommended before running lncRNA mode. Enhancers are cell/tissue-type specific, so the correct Roadmap Epigenomics ID must be specified. Setting the number of flanking genes (numFlankingGenes) to a high value (>20) in EpiMix_PlotProbe may blow the internal memory. Running batch correction with Combat is computationally expensive and requires tuning the cores parameter.

workflows.name: epimix_custom_data_analysis
workflows.intent: Run the core EpiMix analysis on user-provided DNA methylation, gene expression, and sample annotation data across different genomic element modes.
input: methylation_matrix.csv (DNA methylation beta values with CpG sites in rows and samples in columns)
expression_matrix.csv (matched gene expression data with genes in rows and samples in columns)
sample_metadata.csv (sample group annotations with 'primary' and 'sample.type' columns)
workflows.stages: 1. Specify the output directory and run EpiMix in Regular mode to analyze cis-regulatory elements of protein-coding genes ;; 2. Run EpiMix in Enhancer mode using a Roadmap Epigenomics tissue/cell ID to target distal enhancers ;; 3. Run EpiMix in miRNA mode using matched miRNA expression data ;; 4. Run EpiMix in lncRNA mode using matched lncRNA expression data
workflows.code:
# Regular mode
outputDirectory = tempdir ()
EpiMixResults_Regular <- EpiMix ( methylation.data = MET.data, gene.expression.data = mRNA.data, sample.info = LUAD.sample.annotation, group.1 = "Cancer" , group.2 = "Normal" , met.platform = "HM450" , OutputRoot = outputDirectory)

# Enhancer mode
mode <- "Enhancer"
roadmap.epigenome.ids = "E096"
outputDirectory = tempdir ()
EpiMixResults_Enhancer <- EpiMix ( methylation.data = MET.data, gene.expression.data = mRNA.data, mode = mode, roadmap.epigenome.ids = roadmap.epigenome.ids, sample.info = LUAD.sample.annotation, group.1 = "Cancer" , group.2 = "Normal" , met.platform = "HM450" , OutputRoot = outputDirectory)

# miRNA mode
data (microRNA.data)
mode <- "miRNA"
outputDirectory = tempdir ()
EpiMixResults_miRNA <- EpiMix ( methylation.data = MET.data, gene.expression.data = microRNA.data, mode = mode, sample.info = LUAD.sample.annotation, group.1 = "Cancer" , group.2 = "Normal" , met.platform = "HM450" , OutputRoot = outputDirectory)

# lncRNA mode
data (lncRNA.data)
mode <- "lncRNA"
outputDirectory = tempdir ()
EpiMixResults_lncRNA <- EpiMix ( methylation.data = MET.data, gene.expression.data = lncRNA.data, mode = mode, sample.info = LUAD.sample.annotation, group.1 = "Cancer" , group.2 = "Normal" , met.platform = "HM450" , OutputRoot = outputDirectory)
<<<ENDWORKFLOW

workflows.name: epimix_tcga_workflow
workflows.intent: Download, preprocess, and analyze TCGA DNA methylation and gene expression data for a specific cancer site.
input: cancer_site_code (TCGA cancer site abbreviation, e.g., "OV" or "LUAD")
workflows.stages: 1. Download and preprocess TCGA DNA methylation data ;; 2. Download and preprocess TCGA gene expression data ;; 3. Generate sample annotation mapping tumor and normal samples ;; 4. Run the complete analysis using the one-step wrapper function
workflows.code:
# One-step function
CancerSite <- "OV"
mode <- "Regular"
outputDirectory <- tempdir ()
roadmap.epigenome.ids = "E097"
EpiMixResults <- TCGA_GetData ( CancerSite = CancerSite, mode = mode, roadmap.epigenome.ids = roadmap.epigenome.ids, outputDirectory = outputDirectory, cores = 10 )

# Step-by-step function
METdirectories <- TCGA_Download_DNAmethylation ( CancerSite = "OV" , TargetDirectory = outputDirectory)
METProcessedData <- TCGA_Preprocess_DNAmethylation ( CancerSite = "OV" , METdirectories)
GEdirectories <- TCGA_Download_GeneExpression ( CancerSite = "OV" , TargetDirectory = outputDirectory)
GEProcessedData <- TCGA_Preprocess_GeneExpression ( CancerSite = "OV" , MAdirectories = GEdirectories, mode = mode )
sample.info = TCGA_GetSampleInfo ( METProcessedData = METProcessedData, CancerSite = "OV" , TargetDirectory = outputDirectory)
<<<ENDWORKFLOW

workflows.name: epimix_downstream_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform downstream visualization, pathway enrichment, survival analysis, and miRNA target identification on EpiMix results.
workflows.stages: 1. Generate mixture model, violin, and correlation plots for specific probes ;; 2. Visualize chromatin states, DNA methylation, and transcript structures using genome-browser style plots ;; 3. Perform Gene Ontology (GO) and KEGG pathway enrichment analysis ;; 4. Identify survival-associated CpG sites and plot Kaplan-Meier survival curves ;; 5. Identify potential miRNA targets associated with miRNA methylation changes
workflows.code:
# Mixture model and gene expression plots
plots <- EpiMix_PlotModel ( EpiMixResults = Sample_EpiMixResults_Regular, Probe = "cg14029001" , methylation.data = MET.data, gene.expression.data = mRNA.data, GeneName = "CCND3" )
plots $ MixtureModelPlot
plots $ ViolinPlot
plots $ CorrelationPlot

# Genome-browser style visualization for a gene
gene.name = "CCND2"
met.platform = "HM450"
roadmap.epigenome.id = "E096"
EpiMix_PlotGene ( gene.name = gene.name, EpiMixResults = Sample_EpiMixResults_Regular, met.platform = met.platform, roadmap.epigenome.id = roadmap.epigenome.id )

# Genome-browser style visualization for a probe
probe.name = "cg00374492"
numFlankingGenes = 10
roadmap.epigenome.id = "E096"
EpiMix_PlotProbe (probe.name, EpiMixResults = Sample_EpiMixResults_Regular, met.platform = "HM450" , numFlankingGenes = numFlankingGenes, roadmap.epigenome.id = roadmap.epigenome.id, left.gene.margin = 10000 , right.gene.margin = 10000 )

# Pathway enrichment analysis (GO)
methylation.state = "all"
enrich.method = "GO"
selected.pathways = "BP"
enrich.results <- functionEnrich ( EpiMixResults = Sample_EpiMixResults_Regular, methylation.state = methylation.state, enrich.method = enrich.method, ont = selected.pathways, simplify = TRUE , save.dir = "" )

# Pathway enrichment analysis (KEGG)
enrich.results <- functionEnrich ( EpiMixResults = Sample_EpiMixResults_Regular, methylation.state = "all" , enrich.method = "KEGG" , simplify = TRUE , save.dir = "" )

# Biomarker identification (Survival analysis)
CancerSite = "LUAD"
survival.CpGs <- GetSurvivalProbe ( EpiMixResults = Sample_EpiMixResults_miRNA, TCGA_CancerSite = CancerSite)

# Plot Kaplan-Meier survival curve
Probe = "cg00909706"
CancerSite = "LUAD"
EpiMix_PlotSurvival ( EpiMixResults = Sample_EpiMixResults_miRNA, plot.probe = Probe, TCGA_CancerSite = CancerSite)

# Find potential miRNA targets
miRNA_targets <- find_miRNA_targets ( EpiMixResults = Sample_EpiMixResults_miRNA, geneExprData = mRNA.data )
<<<ENDWORKFLOW
